start.title: Lágrimas al amanecer
start.text:
La tumba está abierta. Él ya no está.
Tus lágrimas caen sobre la piedra fría.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Stay. Hope is closer than you know.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay and weep at the door

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Anger blinds the eyes to wonder.

run_consequence.title: No huyas
run_consequence.text:
El amor no huye ante una tumba vacía.
Quédate. Algo sagrado aguarda aquí.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay and weep at the door

curse_consequence.title: Sin ira
curse_consequence.text:
Nadie se lo ha llevado. Calma.
Deja que tus lágrimas hablen por ti.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stay and weep at the door

angels_ask.title: Dos de blanco
angels_ask.text:
Dos figuras resplandecientes te preguntan con dulzura:
"Mujer, ¿por qué lloras?"

boast_consequence.title: Sin orgullo
boast_consequence.text:
Este dolor no es solo tuyo.
Habla con sencillez. Cuéntales tu pena.

demand_consequence.title: Sin exigencias
demand_consequence.text:
El cielo no responde a exigencias.
Habla con suavidad. Deja que se note el amor.

stranger.title: Alguien detrás de ti
stranger.text:
Te vuelves. Una figura se recorta bajo una luz tenue.
Piensas que es el hortelano.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Listen. He is about to speak.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Speak to Him in plain hope
[TODO:es] Accuse Him of moving the body

ignore_consequence.title: No le des la espalda
ignore_consequence.text:
Él te aguarda con paciencia.
Alza la mirada y habla.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Speak to Him in plain hope

accuse_consequence.title: Sin acusaciones
accuse_consequence.text:
No hieras al desconocido.
Pregunta con sencillez y serás escuchada.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Speak to Him in plain hope
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your words soften to a plea.

gardener_dialog.title: Dime dónde
gardener_dialog.text:
"Señor, si te lo has llevado tú, dime dónde lo has puesto
y yo me lo llevaré".

beg_consequence.title: Calma tu ser
beg_consequence.text:
La ira ahoga la voz que tanto anhelas.
Aquieta tu corazón y escucha.

walk_consequence.title: No te marches
walk_consequence.text:
Lo que buscas está a tu lado.
Date la vuelta. Quédate aquí.

name_called.title: Él pronuncia tu nombre
name_called.text:
Una sola palabra. Suave. Familiar.
"María". El mundo se detiene.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Reason it must be someone else

doubt_consequence.title: Confía en la Voz
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] No other voice has called you home.
Let your name reach your heart.

reason_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Beyond Reason
reason_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Some moments do not bend to logic.
Turn. See with your own eyes.

recognition.title: [TODO:es] Rabboni
recognition.text:
[TODO:es] It is Him. Alive. Radiant.
"Rabboni!" bursts from your lips.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Cling to Him with all your strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Joy does not need to grasp.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Faint and look away in fear
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Lift your eyes. He is here.

cling_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Do Not Hold On
cling_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He says, "Do not cling to me.
I have not yet ascended."

faint_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Rise and See
faint_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He is not a ghost. He is risen.
Lift your eyes and meet Him.

do_not_cling.title: [TODO:es] Go to My Brothers
do_not_cling.text:
[TODO:es] "Go tell my brothers," He says.
"I ascend to my Father and yours."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Go at once with His message
[TODO:es] Argue they will not believe you

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] He Sends You
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] This joy is meant to be carried.
Go. The others wait in darkness.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Go at once with His message

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Tell Them Anyway
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Belief is not yours to give.
Your task is only to tell.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Go at once with His message

tell_disciples.title: [TODO:es] I Have Seen the Lord
tell_disciples.text:
[TODO:es] Hands trembling, you knock and speak:
"I have seen the Lord!"

pride_end_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Joy for All
pride_end_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] This morning belongs to everyone.
Give the news, not yourself.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You lower your voice in awe.

whisper_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Speak Clearly
whisper_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Hope must be heard to be carried.
Lift your voice. Tell them all.

ending.title: [TODO:es] He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
[TODO:es] He called your name. You are changed.
The morning belongs to hope.
